setspec.lessonname: Optimized Drill Practice of World Countries

unit.unitinstructions:
🗺 Countries Tutor CIA Maps

This geography lesson practices 233 locator maps, with each card highlighting one country or territory for you to identify.

  • What you will do: Type the place name from memory instead of choosing from multiple-choice options.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate visual feedback follows each response, and the audio panel can also speak the correct answer aloud.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings back places you miss or hesitate on and spaces out the ones you already know.

Use coastlines, region, and overall shape as clues, then press Begin when you are ready.
